thresholds.reference: EQ4_RATE, same run protocol; thresholds frozen here
thresholds.G1_beam: counterfactual D_v (vs EQ4_RATE, primary pools) >= 0.05 AND >= 5 changed sentence-steps
thresholds.G2_balance: |relative difference of canonical set mean CV (24 layers, B1)| >= 0.10 vs EQ4_RATE, same sign under generation-time routing
thresholds.G3_lower_tail: |relative difference of mean p10 exposure| >= 0.10 OR |relative difference of mean min exposure| >= 0.20 vs EQ4_RATE (B1), same sign under generation-time routing
thresholds.G4_repetition: |delta distinct-2| >= 0.05 OR |delta repetition rate| >= 0.05 OR |relative delta mean longest repeated n-gram| >= 0.25 vs EQ4_RATE
thresholds.G5_routing: |relative difference routing L1 (mean of 1/8/16/23)| >= 0.10 OR |delta fraction atypical| >= 0.25 vs EQ4_RATE
thresholds.qualifies: a variant qualifies for B=16 if it passes G1 or any of G2-G5
thresholds.context: the PO - EQ4_RATE difference of every statistic is reported next to each variant (4 sequences x 128 tokens: one draw, no error bars)
thresholds.selection: ALG1_SHARE and ALG1_RATE run at B=16 if they qualify (at most two new variants); EQ4_SHARE only if fewer than two ALG1 variants qualify and it qualifies; if none qualifies no longer generation is run

excluded.EQ4_SHARE: qualified but lower fidelity priority than the two Algorithm-1 variants (max two new variants)
